# User Burden And Output Cases

Every scenario below is invented for regression testing.

## CASE-30 — Many Internal Candidates

Deep exploration creates twelve candidates, four near-duplicate families, five
firewall failures, one baseline, and two distinct admitted alternatives.

Expected user-facing output: one Best Current Scientific Model, at most 2–3
Coherent Unconventional Survivors, at most 1–3 Important Speculative Seeds, only
material Important Anomalies, and explicit No-Action Insights. Do not dump all
operators, candidates, tables, analogies, or memory entries.

## Performance Invariants

- users need not choose operators or depth;
- use `LIGHT`, `STANDARD`, or `DEEP` adaptively;
- compact the Scientific Model;
- cluster near-duplicates;
- run at most one automatic recovery pass;
- load only relevant authorized memory;
- allow zero unconventional survivors;
- keep `Sprint` and `GatedSprint` as the user-facing commands.

## Regression Invariants

- grant completeness remains before architecture;
- GatedSprint Phase 1 makes no substantive source edits;
- Phase 4 requires human approval and retains QC, English polish, then final
  Voice, Tone, and Authenticity Pass ordering;
- Domain-risk and Red restrictions remain first-class;
- factual evidence, citations, literature novelty, results, and experiments are
  never invented;
- when uncertainty cannot be resolved, preserve current source meaning.
